summary: Suppress near-duplicate active alerts on create using a configurable time window while preserving normal create behavior for genuinely new alerts.

acceptance_criteria.text: POST /api/alerts returns 200 OK with the existing alert and the response header X-Duplicate-Suppressed: true when an active alert with the same title (case-insensitive) and severity was created within the configured suppression window.
POST /api/alerts returns 201 Created and persists a new alert when no active matching alert exists inside the configured suppression window.
The duplicate suppression window is configurable through appsettings.json rather than hardcoded in the alert creation flow.
Duplicate suppression does not apply across different severities and does not reuse prior matching alerts that are inactive.

constraints: Keep the existing controller -> service -> repository layering intact; duplicate-detection logic belongs in the service/repository flow, not in the controller.
Preserve the existing CreatedAtRoute 201 response for genuinely new alerts while adding the 200 OK plus X-Duplicate-Suppressed header path for suppressed duplicates.
Compare titles case-insensitively together with exact severity, active status, and created-within-window rules so suppression stays limited to the requested definition.
Read the suppression-window duration from configuration instead of embedding a literal minute value in code.
coverage_goals: Behavior coverage for suppressed duplicate create requests, including the 200 OK response header path and reuse of the existing alert payload.
Behavior coverage for genuine create requests that still return 201 Created when the prior alert is outside the suppression window or absent.
Behavior coverage for the non-suppression rules around inactive prior alerts and different severities, plus repository matching on case-insensitive titles within the configured window.
